key_facts: The Army selected Anduril Industries to deliver the edge computing tier for NGC2, per PEO C3N officials.
The award was issued under Other Transaction Authority and covers integration of Anduril's Lattice software onto forward vehicles.
Officials said the decision turned on demonstrated performance in DDIL conditions rather than raw throughput.
Palantir Technologies retains the enterprise integration layer under a separate agreement, while Lockheed Martin competed for the edge tier but was not selected.

The program requires a Modular Open Systems Approach (MOSA) for all components, and DIU separately issued a solicitation seeking on-vehicle inference for full-motion video weighting degraded-mode behaviour over throughput.
